sources: every create_artifact / add_artifact_modifier site in common/, events/, history/
notes: types[].slot_type is what artifact_slot_type tests; types[].key is what artifact_type tests; bl_category is the key of ck3_artifact_to_bl_items.json items.

Court-slot artifacts (category court: throne, wall_big, pedestal, ...) are equipped too: vanilla tests any_equipped_character_artifact = { artifact_slot_type = throne } (common/character_interactions/00_artifact_interactions.txt:997). Their modifiers (e.g. a wall banner's knight effectiveness) apply to the owner.
Artifact visuals (sword vs longsword, sassanian_sword, ...) cannot be tested by script; only the type key, rarity, features and modifiers can.

script_names.name: any_equipped_character_artifact
script_names.what: trigger (character scope) - iterate equipped artifacts (inventory and court slots)

script_names.name: every_equipped_character_artifact
script_names.what: effect (character scope) - iterate equipped artifacts; use this to emit records

script_names.name: ordered_equipped_character_artifact
script_names.what: effect (character scope) - e.g. the highest-rarity weapon only

script_names.name: artifact_slot_type
script_names.what: trigger (artifact) - inventory slot type: primary_armament | armor | helmet | regalia | ...

script_names.name: artifact_type
script_names.what: trigger (artifact) - type key of common/artifacts/types (sword, armor_mail, ...)

script_names.name: rarity_level
script_names.what: trigger (artifact) - compare with <, >= etc. (1 = common .. 4 = illustrious)

script_names.name: category
script_names.what: trigger (artifact) - inventory | court (the key exists in other scopes too; vanilla_uses is not artifact-only)

script_names.name: has_artifact_modifier
script_names.what: trigger (artifact) - exact modifier key (reads the rolled knight effectiveness exactly)

script_names.name: can_benefit_from_artifact
script_names.what: trigger (character, target artifact) - template can_benefit; false -> only the fallback modifier applies

signature_weapon.note: Character variable signature_weapon (flag) set by set_signature_weapon_effect (common/scripted_effects/00_personal_details_effects.txt:350): the equipped primary_armament artifact type if any, else a random pick. Portrait triggers portrait_should_wield_<x>_trigger (common/scripted_triggers/00_artifact_triggers.txt:555-636). Optional hint for knights without a weapon artifact.

bonus_estimates.method: Exact enumeration of the creation effects (random_list weights incl. pick/unique, if/else on rarity, slot, type, decoration feature groups and wealth) by tools/gen/knights/ck3_eval.mjs. Weapons: decoration first (wealth bands below), then the post-creation block. Stacking: a modifier added twice counts twice (vanilla relies on it: "Base is 1 prowess" + artifact_prowess_1_modifier).

summary_by_rarity.note: Means for ONE freshly created artifact of the type (baseline: no inspiration owner, no special traditions). Prowess is already part of the logged CK3 prowess (ck3xbl_c_prowess) - never add it again. Knight effectiveness belongs to the knights' liege; read it exactly with has_artifact_modifier (knight_effectiveness_modifiers) and use these means only for artifacts whose modifiers are unknown (modded).

bonus_estimates.tournament_prizes: Tournament prize weapons/armour (common/scripted_effects/04_dlc_ep2_tournament_effects.txt:4076-4094) roll add_scaled_artifact_modifier_combat_effect once more: famed 50 %, illustrious always.
